gaps.sentence: Do you know ___ bag this is?
The new law will ___ every driver in the country.
gaps.explanation: 'Affect' is the verb meaning to have an influence on; 'effect' is normally a noun meaning a result.

gaps.sentence: She wore ___ heels to the party.
gaps.explanation: 'High heels' is the fixed collocation; 'tall' is used for people, buildings and trees.

gaps.sentence: The committee acted on legal ___ before revising the clause.
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is the noun; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: We sat ___ to the sound of the waves.
gaps.explanation: 'Listen to' means to pay attention to sound deliberately; after 'sat' the -ing form is needed.

gaps.sentence: Take my ___ and sell the car before the prices fall.
gaps.explanation: 'Take my advice' — the noun form follows the possessive.

gaps.hint: the uncountable activity of travelling in general
gaps.explanation: 'Travel' is uncountable when it means travelling in general; the other options are countable nouns.

gaps.sentence: There is little ___ that the plan will be approved.
gaps.hint: pattern: little ___ that something will happen
gaps.explanation: 'Possibility that ...' is the standard pattern; 'opportunity' means a situation that lets you do something.
